scope: Read-only review of the two existing PHP product records and related official follow-ups. No repository edits.

sources.finding: October 26 addition covers distinct CVE-2026-115560; October 29 addition cites successful-intrusion indicators in certain firewall versions and vendor observations of PHP2Shell attacks. This is not confirmation of named Japanese corporate victims.
Explicitly says both PHP2Shell CVEs entered KEV on October 26. IPA has not identified domestic attack damage.
October 23 session-upload informational advisory and October 26 Windows Brotli rebuild confirmed.
Critical and same branch fixes remain.

newCandidates.alertDateExplanation: JPCERT initial page October 22 does not yet cover this CVE. Revision log explicitly says October 26 added overview and mitigation, which now identify this CVE. Use alert date October 26 for this CVE, not page initial October 22.
newCandidates.affected: 特定の版範囲は未公表。session.serialize_handler を php_binary または php_serialize と設定し、session_start() 前に ini_set() で php へ変更し、session upload progress が有効な組み合わせ。
newCandidates.mitigation: session.upload_progress.enabled=0 として全ワーカーを再起動。通常の次回bugfix releaseで修正予定。既に設定済みなら追加変更不要。
newCandidates.caveat: 開発元がIDを明示しているが公開CVE APIは404。通常リリース前の完全なアドバイザリは未公表。旧2件の範囲・CVSSを転用しない。

newCandidates.condition: cURL extension automatic HTTP response decompression enabled, disabled by default but applications can enable it.
newCandidates.decision: Hold independent product record unless qualifying product-level alert/Critical/exploited/KEV/PoC established. Same CVE already aliases Node.js multi-CVE product record; current global duplicate-ID gate may block a distinct downstream product record. Record audit evidence instead of changing schema.
